input.quote: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The § 2(a) grant runs to "Client" alone: our affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf are not licensed, and there is no mechanism (the Exhibit A site-amendment right in § 2(b)(ii) covers locations only, not additional licensed entities) to add them, so the clause fails even the fallback of affiliate coverage on written notice. § 15 also requires TrueLink's consent for any transfer other than to a financially responsible affiliate, so the licence is not transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction as the fallback requires. The licence is not revocable at TrueLink's discretion (§ 2(c) ties it to the term, and the § 13 cut-offs are breach-based), so this is a deviation rather than walk-away. Redline extends the grant to our affiliates and contractors and adds mutual successor-transfer rights.

proposal.summary: Extend licence grant to Client's affiliates and contractors and permit transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the grant to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, since our group and outsourced providers need to use the Interface in the ordinary course of the licensed business. We have also confirmed that either party may transfer the Agreement to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets without consent; if TrueLink prefers, we can accept affiliate coverage on written notice to TrueLink as a fallback.

ops.oldText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface
ops.newText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client, its affiliates and its contractors acting on Client's behalf a non-exclusive license to use the Interface

ops.oldText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of the assigning party's assets.
